findings.title: Uncapped delay penalties calculated on total contract value
findings.deviation: Liquidated damages are charged at 1% of total contract fees per week up to a 15% cap on total fees, without excluding client-caused delays or specifying LDs as the sole remedy.
findings.impact: AtliQ risks excessive financial penalties calculated against the entire contract value even for minor milestone delays and even when delays are caused by the client.
findings.quote: For any delay in achieving a Milestone, the Vendor shall pay liquidated damages of one percent (1%) of the total fees for each week of delay, subject to a maximum of fifteen percent (15%) of the total fees.
findings.counterPosition: 0.5% of the affected milestone fee per week, capped at 5% of that milestone fee; no LDs where delay is caused by the client; LDs are the sole and exclusive remedy for delay.

findings.title: Deliverables vest on creation prior to full payment
findings.deviation: Deliverables vest in the client upon creation rather than upon receipt of payment.
findings.impact: The client acquires ownership of all deliverables immediately upon creation even if AtliQ is not paid for the services.
findings.quote: All Deliverables shall vest in the Company upon creation.
findings.counterPosition: Client owns deliverables created specifically for it upon payment; AtliQ retains background IP and grants a non-exclusive, perpetual, royalty-free licence to use it as part of the deliverables.

findings.title: One-way confidentiality protecting only client information
findings.deviation: Confidentiality obligations apply solely to AtliQ regarding Company information, with no protection for AtliQ's confidential information.
findings.impact: AtliQ's proprietary tools, technical know-how, and commercial information shared during the project remain completely unprotected.
findings.quote: The Vendor shall keep confidential all information of the Company and its principals (manufacturers), during the term and for five (5) years thereafter.
findings.counterPosition: Make definitions and obligations mutual, protecting both parties' confidential information under identical terms for a fixed 2–3 year period.

findings.title: One-way uncapped vendor indemnity for all losses
findings.deviation: AtliQ provides a broad, uncapped indemnity for all losses arising out of the services or acts/omissions, without mutuality or fault exclusions.
findings.impact: AtliQ is exposed to unlimited financial liability for any losses connected to the services, regardless of client negligence or fault.
findings.quote: The Vendor shall indemnify the Company against all losses arising out of the Services or any act or omission of the Vendor or its personnel.
findings.counterPosition: Each party indemnifies the other for third-party claims caused by its own breach or negligence; no indemnity for losses caused by the indemnified party's own negligence; indemnities subject to the liability cap (IP infringement excepted).

findings.title: One-sided liability cap leaving AtliQ uncapped
findings.deviation: The agreement caps the Company's liability at 3 months of fees while leaving AtliQ's liability completely uncapped.
findings.impact: AtliQ faces unlimited exposure to claims while the client's total exposure to AtliQ is severely restricted.
findings.quote: The Company's liability shall not exceed the fees paid in the preceding three (3) months.
findings.counterPosition: Mutual cap of 1× fees paid or payable in the 12 months before the claim; carve-outs limited to fraud, wilful misconduct and breach of confidentiality.

findings.title: One-sided convenience termination paying accepted milestones only
findings.deviation: Convenience termination is available only to the Company and restricts payment to accepted milestones, excluding unbilled work in progress.
findings.impact: The client can terminate for convenience and refuse to compensate AtliQ for substantial work in progress performed prior to termination.
findings.quote: The Company may terminate for convenience on fifteen (15) days' notice. The Vendor shall be paid for accepted Milestones only.
findings.counterPosition: Payment for all services performed up to termination, including work in progress and committed costs; mutual notice period.

fine.note: 12-month non-solicitation of client staff is within acceptable playbook parameters.
